set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin work/photomap-straighten-20260912
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "f2763215fa2c42659397758e10462ea2c7e4866e"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/work/photomap-straighten-20260912)" = "f2763215fa2c42659397758e10462ea2c7e4866e"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd frontend
npm run test -- src/components/admin/latestRequestGuard.test.ts
npm run lint
npm run build
cd ..
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-photoqueue-e2e-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/admin-photo-race.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin-lazy-loading.spec.ts e2e/visual/admin.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert 'visual:'
cd ..
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
